description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh: 命令内容。长度为2~2048个字符。
description.en: The content of the command. The content must be 2 to 2,048 characters in length.

description.zh: 执行命令的节点信息列表。
description.en: The information of nodes on which the command is run.

description.zh:
第N个执行命令的节点实例ID。
>用于限定执行范围，不指定则默认在集群所有节点上执行。
description.en:
The ID of the Nth node instance on which the command is run.

> This parameter specifies the node on which the command is run. If it is not specified, the command will be run on all nodes of the cluster.

description.zh:
超时时间，超时将终止命令进程。单位：秒

默认值：60
description.en:
The timeout period. If a command times out, the command process will be terminated. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60.

description.zh: 命令工作目录。默认值为`/root`。
description.en: The working directory of the command. Default value: `/root`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc invoke-shell-command --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command echo_hello_world --working-dir /home --timeout 3600 --instance Id=i-bp1in9hmw3ur52x00000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
